name: humangated
description: The translation-free review loop for you and your coding agent: hgd-share (prototypes + prompts), hgd-ask (named humans, your question attached), hgd-pull (judgment back — suggested edits as ready-to-apply diffs), hgd-status, hgd-trail, hgd-list, hgd-delete, hgd-config, hgd-unblock. Ships hooks: a PreToolUse guard that refuses work inside an open gate's scope, a SessionStart digest, and a Stop re-check.
